name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/pipeline
description: Rebuilds a Quartz 5 site's configured transformer pipeline, minus an optional denylist, for content Quartz does not parse itself. See CONTEXT.md.
//exports: Source only: no build and no dist. The consuming plugin's build inlines it (ADR-0005).
//peerDependencies: Quartz's shared packages: the host's own copies, which the pipeline runs a site's transformers with, so a consuming plugin takes them as peers too and its build leaves them external. Never installed here, or that plugin's build would bundle this copy (the shared-packages repo guard, #98); the typecheck reads Core's (tsconfig.json).
//devDependencies: Types, and what the probe plugin in e2e/ needs.
